future_container_interfaces.dot_calls: Expand only the previously accepted exact _dot syntax/projection, pinning the same function body. No new hand-written dot opcode with unproved source-call binding.
future_container_interfaces.fixed_domain: weights : Fin m -> Real; differences : Fin n -> Fin m -> Real; 0 < n; original specialization n=4,m=80
future_container_interfaces.fsum_semantics: Ordered left addition fold in exact Real, using Q4 orderedFsum_eq_sum only after structural denotation. CPython compensated fsum semantics remains open.
future_container_interfaces.index_semantics: Only proven Fin-index access; ragged or mismatched source lists are refused by the projection-domain adapter. The actual Python _objective does not itself assert this domain.
future_container_interfaces.literal_L2_binding: Keep .var "L2" in the emitted source syntax. Later exact-original projection supplies originalRealMu, whose Rat is 5764607523034235 / 576460752303423488. Never substitute decimal 1/100 for this binary64 value.
future_container_interfaces.prefix_program: margins -> data -> regularizer -> factors -> gradient, as five typed lets in original statement order
future_container_interfaces.zip_semantics: Generic source list semantics uses min(length(left), length(right)). Equal-length typed vectors require an explicit shape witness before specialization; no silent padding/default values.

kernel_interfaces.compile: compileScalar {slots} (scope : String -> Option (Fin slots)) (source : SourceScalar) : Except SliceError (ScalarIR slots)
kernel_interfaces.error_identity: Errors contain a stable kind and optional lexical name. AST spans/provenance are host receipt data, never proof premises for arithmetic equality.
kernel_interfaces.named_evaluation: evalSourceExact (environment : String -> Except SliceError Real) (source : SourceScalar) : Except SliceError Real
kernel_interfaces.preservation_obligation: compileScalar scope source = .ok program -> evalSourceExact (namesFromScope scope environment) source = evalExact program environment
kernel_interfaces.tree_evaluation_order: Unary operands first; binary left then right; condition once then only selected branch. Repeated source exp calls remain repeated nodes; arithmetic is not normalized by the host compiler.
kernel_interfaces.typed_evaluation: evalExact {slots} (program : ScalarIR slots) (environment : Fin slots -> Real) : Except SliceError Real
kernel_interfaces.why_preservation_is_conditional_on_accep: Both branches must compile, but only the selected branch evaluates. A refused dead branch can still have a defined source denotation; unconditional compile.bind/eval commutation would be false.

refusal_protocol.deny_behavior: No fallback to eval, ranker import, source execution, Float arithmetic, default coordinates, or unproved whole-function support. Keep failed/unsupported inputs distinct from qualified artifacts.

scalar_operations.policy: Source 0.0, 0, 1, 2 used by these leaves are exact. General Float literal conversion requires a separately pinned backend policy; refuse unsupported literal classes.
Unknown/free name refused; no dictionary fallback or default zero.
Retain source tree and left-to-right visitation. NaN/infinity/signed-zero/rounding are outside this backend.
Real.exp; positivity supplied by Real.exp_pos, not a Python libm theorem.
Real.log(1 + operand); otherwise logDomain error. The source stable-loss operand is exp(-abs(z)) and has positive 1+operand.
Real division when nonzero; otherwise divisionByZero error. Do not exploit Lean total division by zero to accept a Python-invalid input.

scalar_operations.domain: all Real conditions; selected branch domain only
scalar_operations.policy: Exactly 0 <= condition; lazy evaluation. Reject unsupported syntax in either source branch during compilation.

scalar_syntax.condition_lowering: Only an AST Compare(test, [GtE], [Constant(0)]) lowers to ifNonneg. Preserve test/then/else order; do not change the comparison or substitute a sigmoid opcode.
scalar_syntax.typed_variables: var(slot : Fin slots); all other supported constructors preserve the source operator tree
